title: OperationOutcome
description: The operation.outcome JSON-RPC result: what the backend retained about one mutation identity. It answers the person who stopped waiting, and it never implies a rollback — a timeout is not evidence that the effect did not happen.

outcome.description: The closed set of answers. 'not-started' — no work ran, so a retry cannot double an effect. 'done' — the work finished (it may have answered an error; it is not still running). 'outcome-unknown' — it has not finished, so the person is checking what happened and may ask again while the record is retained. 'unknown' — nothing is retained: the identity was never seen, its retention ran out, or the backend restarted.

operation.description: The catalogue operation the record belongs to, or the empty string where no record exists. It is what a surface names when it says what to look at instead of an answer.
